rulesTestNames: lets current managers get contact, application and attendance report views by id
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels attendance report view triggers
read: current organizer managers get by id while their account is not deleted; a view not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; rebuilt from the event's attendees, its closeout decisions and the event itself, deleted when the event is gone or its roster is over the report limit
migrationNotes: view equals what getEventAttendanceReport returns as of view.serverTime. Events that ended before the triggers have no view until their next attendee or closeout write; Host close-out then shows its own counts without the report section.
getEventAttendanceReport was retired in Nov 2026 after the Host 1.0.6 floor raise (#2174); getEventAttendanceDisposition stays deployed and recordEventNoShow is the command.
